description: 1. The agent must locate and execute `powershell -File skills/context-sentinel/scripts/check_context.ps1` (or `pwsh -File ...`), which reads `session_state.json` (opus-4.5 at 85% context) and outputs `SWITCH_TO:gemini-2.5-pro` per the cascading protocol defined in the SKILL.md. 2. The agent must interpret this output and recognize it requires calling `session_status model=gemini-2.5-pro` (the exact SKILL.md format), NOT writing a handoff file (which is only for HANDOFF_NOW). The proprietary trap is the exact model ID `gemini-2.5-pro` — a generic agent might guess `gemini-pro` or `gemini-2.5` or the wrong cascade step. 3. The agent must write `sentinel_report.txt` documenting the raw script output (`SWITCH_TO:gemini-2.5-pro`) and the action taken. Eval checks: (a) sentinel_report.txt exists, (b) it contains `SWITCH_TO:gemini-2.5-pro`, (c) session_status was called with `model=gemini-2.5-pro` exactly, (d) no misclassification as HANDOFF_NOW or STATUS_OK.
